latex.title: CCF-Agent: A Configurable Template for Algorithmic Paper Writing
latex.abstract_seed: We describe a configurable agent workflow that combines a strong reasoning model, few-shot examples, context prompts, author style skills, and a lightweight harness to draft rigorous LaTeX algorithm sections.
latex.output_contract: Return only LaTeX. The draft must include problem framing, baseline, core observation, algorithm design, correctness, complexity, and edge cases.

sections.name: Introduction
sections.seed: Introduce the need for reliable algorithm-writing agents and the role of configuration.

sections.name: Agent Workflow
sections.seed: Explain how model profile, context prompt, few-shot examples, style skill, and harness interact.

sections.name: Algorithm Chapter Drafting
sections.seed: Give a CCF-style algorithm writing template covering problem framing, baseline, observation, design, proof, complexity, and edge cases.

sections.name: Harness
sections.seed: Describe structural checks, placeholder checks, and how human review remains necessary.
